svg.text: ESP32-WROOM-32 <-> EPSON LX-810L - Centronics parallel interface (IEEE-1284) / ESC-P
DATA BUS D0..D7 ( Dn' = Dn at 5 V level, TXS0108E output )
STATUS DIVIDERS - 5 V -> ~3.2 V ( the ESP32 is not 5 V tolerant )
PULL-UPS - /STROBE and /INIT: 3V3 straight to the DB25 + 10k to +5V
1. +5V from the DevKit's 5V/VIN pin (via USB) powers
the TXS0108E's VCCB and the pull-ups. +3V3 -> VCCA.
2. Common GND: ESP32 + TXS0108E + divider bases
3. TXS0108E only on the 8 bits D0..D7. If the print
comes out garbled, swap for a 74HCT541 / 74HCT245.
4. /STROBE and /INIT: 3.3V is a valid TTL-high level,
so they go straight to the DB25 (with a 10k pull-up).
7. Dn' = Dn at 5V level (TXS0108E B side).
